fields.name: FocusPlayer
fields.evidence: GoalSystem::Update (EoCClient.dll+0x84FED0): *(uint16*)comp = result of ecl::splitscreen::GetForceMergePlayerFocus (byte 0 value, byte 1 has-value) when that has a value; set to 0 when a forced merge query has entities. ViewSystem::Update (EoCClient.dll+0x834200) uses it: view = focus + 1 when byte 1 is set, i.e. 0 = player 1, 1 = player 2. Default 0, live 0. Windows: GoalSystem per-frame update bg3.exe+0x192E320 takes this 2-byte singleton (stride 2, writable), clears byte +1 when set, and stores the 2-byte result of GetForceMergePlayerFocus (bg3.exe+0x1B30410) into +0 when its byte 1 is set.

fields.name: IsSet
fields.evidence: GoalSystem::Update clears byte 1 at the start of every frame and sets it with the focus; ViewSystem::Update tests byte 1 before using byte 0 (an ls::Optional<uint8_t>-like pair). Default 0, live 0. Windows: bg3.exe+0x192E320 'if (*(char*)(p+1)) *(char*)(p+1) = 0' at the start of the frame.

open_questions: Names are ours (the pair behaves like ls::Optional<uint8_t> of a player index).
second_pass: Offsets and widths confirmed on Windows in the GoalSystem update bg3.exe+0x192E320: a 2-byte singleton, byte +1 cleared each frame, 2-byte store of GetForceMergePlayerFocus's {value, has-value} pair.
